scope: Prompt developed against the validation split only. The test split is run once with the final prompt (pause-llm-prompt-v1) and reported as-is, whether or not it beats the baselines. Synthetic single-author data; not a fraud or real-world accuracy estimate. LLM output is advisory and never gates release.
baselines_note: Validation micro precision/recall/F1 for rules and linear are frozen in models/validation-report.json (rules and linear). Validation TF-IDF row predictions are unavailable; the linear variant is omitted on validation. Test TF-IDF uses frozen reports/classifier-final.json rows, including ABSTAIN triggered labels.
